hub.notFoundBody: We could not find this campaign in your list.
hub.paused: Recording is paused for now. You can see your missions below, and recording reopens when the campaign resumes.
hub.closed: This campaign has ended. You can still see your missions below, but you can no longer record.

profile.title: About you
profile.intro: A few details help us match your voice to the right project. Everything is required.
profile.privacy: Your name never travels with your audio: only a pseudonymous speaker ID does.
profile.variety: Which variety of {language} do you speak?
profile.varietyOtherTitle: This campaign is for a different variety
profile.varietyOtherBody: This campaign is for speakers of the varieties listed. If you speak another variety, please contact the Afriklang team. They can tell you about other campaigns that may suit you.
profile.deviceHint: You can change this, for example Samsung A14.

required.variety: Choose the variety of the language you speak.
required.country: Choose the country you live in.
required.device: Enter the phone or device you record with.

errors.tooLong: This is too long: {max} characters at most (you typed {count}).
errors.invalid: Choose one of the options in the list.
errors.noLetters: Use letters or numbers, not only symbols or spaces.
errors.control: Remove the line breaks or special characters.

server.variety: This variety was not accepted for this language. Choose one from the list.
server.country: This country was not accepted. Choose one from the list.
server.region: This region was not accepted. Enter a region or city name, 80 characters at most.
server.gender: This answer was not accepted. Choose one of the options.
server.age_band: This age group was not accepted. Choose one of the options.
server.device: This device name was not accepted. Enter a short name, 80 characters at most.

profile.noVarietiesTitle: No variety to choose from yet
profile.noVarietiesBody: This campaign does not list its language varieties yet, so the profile cannot be completed. Please contact the Afriklang team.

blocked.title: This campaign is not available for your profile
blocked.body: The variety you gave does not match the one this campaign is looking for. The Afriklang team has been told and will get in touch if another campaign suits you.
blocked.fix: If you made a mistake, you can correct your profile and the campaign will open again.

consent.accountSummary: By agreeing, you allow Afriklang to record your voice and to process it to build speech datasets. You can withdraw from any campaign at any time.
consent.campaignSummary: By agreeing, you take part in the campaign {code} (topic: {topic}). Your recordings will be used as described in the text. You can withdraw from this campaign at any time.
consent.agreeFirst: Tick the box above once you have read the text to continue.
consent.changed: The consent text has changed, so please read it again before you agree.
consent.notConfigured: The consent text is not ready yet for this campaign. Please contact the Afriklang team.
consent.noLink: The consent text link is missing. Please contact the Afriklang team.

instructions.title: How to record
instructions.quiet: Find a quiet room. Switch off TV, radio and fans.
instructions.mic: Hold the phone {min} to {max} cm from your mouth.
instructions.micMin: Hold the phone at least {min} cm from your mouth.
instructions.micMax: Hold the phone at most {max} cm from your mouth.
instructions.level: Speak clearly and loud enough: the recording must reach at least {level} dBFS on average. The app checks this for you.
instructions.silence: Stay silent for about {s} second before you start and after you finish.

read.name: Read aloud
read.help: Read the sentence on screen out loud, naturally, as you would say it to someone.

spontaneous.name: Speak freely
spontaneous.help: Talk about the topic or question shown, in your own words, until the timer allows.

conversational.name: Conversation
conversational.help: Talk with your partner about the scenario shown. One of you presses record on one phone, and both of you are credited.

instructions.withdrawBody: You will not be able to record for this campaign any more, and the team will be told. Your consent to record in general stays.

missions.title: Your missions
missions.accepted: {n, plural, one {# accepted recording} other {# accepted recordings}}
missions.emptyBody: Missions will appear here as soon as the team has prepared them.
missions.allDone: Nothing left to record right now. Thank you!
missions.noReason: The team asked for a new take.
missions.partnerWait: Your partner has not finished their consent yet. You can record once they have.
missions.loadError: We could not load your missions.
